title: 第11章 大爆特爆一夜暴富第12章 突破境界百年结算
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
伴随着那一身脆响，储物袋上的禁制直接碎裂，化作一缕缕灵光消散在空气中。
虽是暴力破除，却被李玄霄精准控制了剑气威力，并未伤及储物袋内的诸多宝贝，只是储物袋本身因禁制破碎，彻底失去了储物之能。
又是“哗啦！”一声，一堆天材地宝从袋中散落而出，铺满了整个洞府地面。
李玄霄缓缓睁开双眼，望着眼前的景象，不由得感慨一声，眼底闪过惊叹与期待：“前世玩凡俗游戏，打boss大爆宝物，恐也没有今日这般大场面吧？！”
只见地面之上元晶堆积如山，有的元晶赤红，有的泛着淡蓝，属性不同却都散发着浓郁的仙韵。
各类天材地宝、妖族天庭制式丹药散落在这元晶堆上。
还有一株灵植傲然挺立，其叶片上还沾着几滴晶莹的露珠，灵气氤氲其间。
还有几件泛着丝丝灵蕴的后天灵宝，静静躺在元晶堆中，透着不凡的威能。
“难怪都说马无夜草不肥，人无横财不富！”
李玄霄嘴角的笑意完全压制不住：“马元啊马元！马元啊马元！”
好一会儿后，李玄霄这才压下心中的躁动，指尖轻挥，一股柔和的灵气化作一阵清风席卷而出，将散落的天材地宝一一归拢。
“让我仔细看看这些宝贝都有什么！”
地面之上，最显眼的是八堆属性不同的元晶。
分别是那金、木、水、火、土、风、雷和无属性的纯粹仙元晶。
元晶有属性之别，也有下品、中品、上品、极品之分。
这些元晶可用于修炼时辅助吸纳天地灵气、温养丹田仙元。
也是煅器、炼丹的绝佳材料，是布置防御阵法时的灵力来源。
此外，元晶亦是修士间交易的硬通货，这些元晶品级不低，即便是太乙金仙修士，也颇为珍视。
“洪荒世界毕竟是一个真实世界，除了那些高高在上的仙神大能，也有寻常修士，以物易物终究还是不方便的，有此元晶倒也可以理解。”
“前世看小说神话，目光总是聚焦在天地大能、三清圣人、三教高徒身上，倒是从未想过寻常仙神、散修在这洪荒之上的修炼与生活。或许和那些修仙文里面描述的差不多？还有散修的集会和拍卖不成？”

李玄霄微微摇头，收拢了心神，继续盘点收获。
除却元晶外，最多的便是那些灵材。
李玄霄俯身拾起一枚拳头大小、通体莹白的灵材，入手温润如玉，隐隐有玉质光泽流转，正是“羊脂玉髓”，可洗髓伐脉、提纯道体，搭配锻体之法修炼，能事半功倍。
此外，还有其他各种灵材，不一一赘述。
丹药则被装在一个个刻着古老妖文的玉瓶中，瓶身萦绕着淡淡的药香与仙韵，皆是妖族天庭制式，品质远超寻常丹药。
李玄霄拿起一瓶贴着“淬体丹”标签的玉瓶，拔开塞子，一股浓郁的药香扑面而来，内里盛着三枚赤红如焰的丹药，服用后可快速强化肉身，化解修炼锻体之法时的滞涩感。
另一瓶“万灵丹”能快速补充自身灵气，应对突发战事或长时间修炼的消耗，只是里面空空如也，已被消耗一空。
李玄霄又拿起来一个玉瓶，上面标注着“气血丹”，这是能够补充气血、疗愈伤势的丹药，同样是个空瓶。
看得出，那通臂魔猿在重伤之前，是经历了一场极为惨烈的战斗。
最让李玄霄惊喜的是一瓶“悟灵丹”，其瓶身泛着淡淡的金光，内里只有两枚丹药，服用后可短暂屏蔽外界干扰，提升法则领悟力。
content_en:
With that crisp sound, the restrictions on the storage bag shattered and turned into wisps of spiritual light that dissipated in the air.
Although it was broken violently, Li Xuanxiao accurately controlled the power of the sword and did not harm the many treasures in the storage bag. However, the storage bag itself was broken due to the restriction and completely lost its ability to store items.
There was another "Crash!" and a pile of heavenly materials and earthly treasures scattered out of the bag, covering the entire cave floor.
Li Xuanxiao slowly opened his eyes and looked at the scene in front of him. He couldn't help sighing, and his eyes flashed with wonder and expectation: "In my previous life, I played ordinary games and fought bosses to explode treasures. I'm afraid there wasn't such a big scene as today?!"
I saw mountains of Yuanjing piled up on the ground. Some Yuanjing was red, and some were light blue. They had different attributes but all exuded a strong fairy charm.
All kinds of heavenly materials, earthly treasures, and standard elixirs of the demon clan are scattered on this pile of Yuan Jing.
There is also a spiritual plant standing proudly, with a few drops of crystal dew on its leaves, filled with spiritual energy.
There are also several acquired spiritual treasures with a hint of spiritual essence, lying quietly in the pile of Yuanjing, revealing extraordinary power.
“No wonder they say a horse won’t get fat without night grass, and a man won’t get rich without windfall!”
Li Xuanxiao couldn't suppress the smile at the corner of his mouth: "Ma Yuan, Ma Yuan! Ma Yuan, Ma Yuan!"
After a while, Li Xuanxiao suppressed the restlessness in his heart. He waved his fingertips lightly, and a soft spiritual energy swept out into a breeze, gathering the scattered treasures of heaven and earth one by one.
"Let me take a closer look at what these babies have!"
On the ground, the most conspicuous thing is eight piles of Yuanjing with different attributes.
They are gold, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, thunder and pure immortal crystal without attributes.
Yuan Jing has different attributes, and can also be divided into low-grade, medium-grade, high-grade, and top-grade.
These crystals can be used to help absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and warm the immortal essence of the Dantian during practice.
It is also an excellent material for forging weapons and elixirs, and is a source of spiritual power when setting up defensive formations.
In addition, Yuanjing is also a hard currency for transactions among monks. These Yuanjings are of high grade, and even the Taiyi Golden Immortal monks value them quite a lot.
"The prehistoric world is a real world after all. In addition to those powerful immortals and gods, there are also ordinary monks. After all, bartering is still inconvenient. It is understandable with this Yuanjing."
"In my previous life, when I read novels and myths, my eyes were always focused on the great powers of heaven and earth, the three pure saints, and the disciples of the three religions. I never thought about the cultivation and life of ordinary immortals, gods, and casual cultivators in this ancient wilderness. Maybe it is similar to what is described in those immortal cultivating articles? There are also gatherings and auctions of casual cultivators?"
Li Xuanxiao shook his head slightly, collected his thoughts, and continued to take stock of the harvest.
Apart from Yuan Jing, the most abundant ones are those spiritual materials.
Li Xuanxiao leaned over and picked up a fist-sized, crystal-white spiritual material. It was as warm and moist as jade, with a faint jade-like luster flowing around it. It was "mutton fat chalcedony", which can cleanse the marrow, cut veins, and purify the Taoist body. When combined with the body-building method, it can achieve twice the result with half the effort.
In addition, there are various other spiritual materials, which I will not go into details one by one.
The elixirs are placed in jade bottles engraved with ancient demonic inscriptions. The bottles are filled with a faint medicinal fragrance and fairy charm. They are all made by the demon clan's heavenly court, and their quality is far superior to ordinary elixirs.
Li Xuanxiao picked up a jade bottle with the label "Body Tempering Pill" and pulled out the stopper. A strong medicinal fragrance hit his face. There were three red pills in it. After taking them, they can quickly strengthen the body and relieve the sluggish feeling when practicing the body-building method.
Another bottle of "Elixir" can quickly replenish one's own spiritual energy to cope with sudden wars or long-term cultivation consumption, but it is empty and has been consumed.
Li Xuanxiao picked up another jade bottle with the label "Qi and Blood Pill" on it. This is a pill that can replenish qi and blood and heal injuries. It is also an empty bottle.
It can be seen that the thong-armed demon ape went through an extremely brutal battle before being seriously injured.
What surprised Li Xuanxiao the most was a bottle of "Enlightenment Pill".The body glows with a faint golden light, and there are only two pills inside. After taking it, it can temporarily block external interference and improve the understanding of the law.
